sql: SELECT "Primary Key", "Ancient Toponym", "Select Bibliography" FROM roman_cities LIMIT 10

WITH split AS ( SELECT TRIM(src) AS src_trim, TRIM(src, ' .') AS src_norm FROM roman_cities CROSS JOIN UNNEST(string_split(COALESCE("Select Bibliography", ''), chr(59))) AS t(src) ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM roman_cities) AS total_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM roman_cities WHERE "Select Bibliography" IS NULL OR TRIM("Select Bibliography") = '') AS rows_no_bibliography, COUNT(*) AS total_source_occurrences, COUNT(DISTINCT src_norm) AS unique_sources_norm, COUNT(DISTINCT src_trim) AS unique_sources_trim_only, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN src_norm <> '' THEN src_norm END) AS unique_sources_nonempty, COUNT(CASE WHEN src_norm = '' THEN 1 END) AS empty_occurrences FROM split

WITH split AS ( SELECT TRIM(src) AS src_trim, TRIM(src, ' .') AS src_norm FROM roman_cities CROSS JOIN UNNEST(string_split(COALESCE("Select Bibliography", ''), chr(59))) AS t(src) ), grouped AS ( SELECT src_norm, COUNT(*) AS n_occurrences, string_agg(DISTINCT src_trim, ' | ') AS example_variants FROM split GROUP BY src_norm ) SELECT src_norm, n_occurrences, example_variants FROM grouped ORDER BY src_norm
